summary: Read-only smoke test of imported WhatsFlow app. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass (health, root, login ok/401, /me, 8 protected endpoints reject no/invalid token, whatsapp status+qr, 14 read-only GETs). Frontend: unauth redirect to /login, login with admin password lands on Dashboard, all 12 sidebar pages load with correct titles and zero JS page errors, WhatsApp page shows state awaiting_qr with QR image rendered, public /teste loads without login. No writes/trials/payments/messages were triggered.

issues: 'Clientes ativos' card shows 0 while Clientes page lists 13 active painel users (likely counts local customers table vs painel cache) - pre-existing behaviour, not a regression
SISTEMA field uses a native <select> instead of shadcn Select (cosmetic, pre-existing)

critical_code_review_comments: App.js calls settingsApi.get() on mount even on /login and /teste (unauthenticated) -> harmless 401, swallowed by catch
Login brute-force map is in-memory per process (resets on restart) - acceptable for single-admin app
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production-connected accounts (painel.fun, InfinitePay, WhatsApp). Only read-only tests were run. Use tests/test_smoke_preview_readonly.py for regression. Many pre-existing repo tests in /app/backend/tests may hit real external services - do not run blindly. WhatsApp service state was awaiting_qr with has_qr=true.
